item.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tours — Fri Sep 25, 10:30 AM — Civic Center
item.description:
Price: Adult $10, Senior/Full Time Student $5 \(Plus a $2 p er ticket service Charge Online\)
Ticket Info:
Sponsor: Marin Center
Link: http://www.marincounty.org/depts/cu
The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. The cost is $10 adults and $5 seniors and students. No reservations are required. Groups of ten or more can arrange a private docent tour by calling the Visitor Services Office at \(415\) 473-3762.

item.title: Slave Play - a Left Edge Theatre Production — Fri Sep 25, 7:30 PM — The California
item.description:
Presented by Left Edge Theatre. At the MacGregor Plantation, the antebellum South collides with the present in a provocative fever dream where race, desire, gender, and power intertwine. Nothing is quite as it seems—and yet everything is. Jeremy O. Harris’s explosive, award-winning Slave Play rips apart the boundaries between history and modern America, confronting the enduring legacy of slavery and the complex intersections of race, gender, and sexuality. Recommended for ages 17\+. Contains nudity, sexual content, simulated sexual violence, and racially violent language. TICKETS ZONE A \(Close to the action\) $45 ZONE B \(Middle of the house\) $35 ZONE C \(In the back\) $25 Tickets at Door - $45 - So buy in advance! SPECIAL DATES Thu 9/25: OPENING NIGHT & PARTY - Stick around to celebrate after the show! Wed 9/30: Industry Night - Calling all theatre people! All tickets $20. Thur 10/1: Discount night - $10 off all tickets Advance purchase strongly encouraged.
Source: North Bay Bohemi

September 26, 2026

**TICKETS:** **$25 General / $20 Seniors & Youth** | **At The Door $35 General / $30 Seniors & Youth (doors at 4:30 p.m.)**
**Hardly Strictly Irish** (Suzuki Cady and Jimmy Murphy) bring an uplifting, warm, and soulful energy, and a signature blend of traditional Irish tunes and Appalachian, country-folk, and roots-Americana songs. Their rich sound features the fiddle, mandolin, guitar, banjo, bodhrán, and vocal harmonies.
**Shiloh Step Irish Dance** will perform and teach a Ceili (group dance) after the show, for anyone interested. Bring a potluck dish (optional) to share after the show in honor of the Harvest Moon!
The venue is beautiful, with great acoustics, comfortable seats, room to dance, and easy parking! And a lovely fountain garden area with seating to enjoy after the show.

item.title: Copperfield's Books Presents Kristin Hannah, In Conversation — Sat Sep 26, 7:30 PM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description:
Kristin Hannah, author of The Nightingale and The Four Winds, comes to the LBC on Saturday, September 26, for a conversation about her newest release, The Women, at once an intimate portrait of coming of age in a dangerous time and an epic tale of a nation divided. Set in 1965, it is a novel about deep friendships and bold patriotism, a richly drawn story with a memorable heroine whose idealism and courage under fire will come to define an era. Join us for this warmhearted reading and conversation followed by a live audience Q&A. Presented by Copperfield's Books, every ticket includes a pre-signed paperback copy of the book, The Women. Photos and video are strictly prohibited for this event
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 27, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
